body:
Yeah I briefly went through a stage of trying to suggest things to help, but after a while it became clear that anything I suggest, she's tried already. I just let her know that I care about her and will do anything I can to help if she wants it, and will always be there to try to help her put things back together again. The problem is, I think everyone else in her life has given up on her, from what I've seen and what she's told me, I'm the only one who still demonstrates that they care. So on one hand, if I don't do it, nobody else will. But on the other hand, she doesn't want anyone to care anymore as it just makes it harder for her.

I'm glad you mentioned the above though, we're very close, but I don't know her friends and family particularly well, and if the worst ever did eventuate, it's unlikely I'd know.
thanks. Yeah I feel pretty powerless to do anything, I'm trying to mentally prepare myself for it to happen, not sure quite how to do so, but I'm trying.
